messages:
alex: FYI — I'm seeing increased 503s from kv-cache on stage (started ~10:12). Spinning up a quick war-room in 5m. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/xyz-123. Agenda: 1) repro 2) temp rollback to v3 3) mitigation (rate-limit + cache clear). Please join if you're on call.

maria: on my way. do we have correlation id? any suspicious deploys?

deploy-bot: Bridge created by alex: https://meet.redwood/xyz-123 (PIN 4829). Recording enabled.

sam: I can grab logs. attaching tail snippet.

sam: ```
stage-kv-1 | ERROR kv-cache: OOM when allocating 5242880 bytes
stage-kv-2 | WARN cache: eviction failing: unexpected nil pointer
```

irina: @luis (ops) — can you standby for a possible node reboot? we might need to clear host-level caches.

luis: standby, will prep access. if rollback needed i can push v2.9.3.

maria: any idea if this is triggered by a recent model quantization change? last deploy looks like model-serving patch.

alex: good call — rollout history shows model-serving:quant-opt bumped at 10:05. can we pin that and test?

sam: repro: sending a 1k token seq with concurrent 60 reqs reproduces 503 within ~20s.

irina: plan: join bridge -> confirm repro -> if repro consistent, rollback model-serving to previous quant profile -> if still failing, reboot node and clear kv cache -> follow up ticket with root-cause.

alex: ok starting now. ping in thread when you join. :thumbsup:

maria: joined on bridge.

luis: joined, have rollback ready.

sam: log tailing in bridge; seeing spike in CGO allocs.

alex: thanks team, will keep notes and post runbook after.
